purpose: Section 14 requires determining exactly what historical depth IBKR (here, the Interactive_Brokers_IBKR MCP connector) can provide before assuming it is sufficient for multi-year intraday research.
method: Live get_price_history calls against real front-month contracts on 2026-09-14, varying step/period/step_count until the tool's own error message or returned range revealed the limit.

findings.result: error: "Combination of period and step will provide more then allowed 1000 data points"
succeeded; returned exactly 1000 bars spanning chart_start=2026-08-26T20:10:00Z to chart_end=2026-09-11T20:55:00Z (~16 calendar days, ~12 RTH trading days)
error: "Combination of period and step will provide more then allowed 1000 data points"
succeeded for all three execution instruments; chart_start=2026-06-15T13:30:00Z to chart_end=2026-09-11T21:00:00Z (~3 calendar months, RTH-only since outside_rth=false)

critical_limitation: The get_price_history tool schema exposes no start/end date parameter and no pagination cursor -- only `period` (a fixed lookback from now) or `step_count` (a bar count from now). There is no way discovered so far to request an older window once the ~1000-bar cap for a given bar size is reached. This means the connector can serve, at most, roughly the MOST RECENT ~2.5 weeks of 5-minute bars or ~3 months of hourly bars, and cannot be paged further back.
conclusion: This connector is NOT sufficient for the multi-year 5-minute-to-4-hour academic replication and backtesting the mandate requires (section 8-11, section 17's 50-60%/20-25%/20-25% chronological split needs years of data). Per section 14, a specialised vendor (Databento, CME DataMine, Barchart, or similar) is required for real Phase 3/4 research. This connector remains useful for: (a) live/near-real-time quotes for the shadow paper-trading engine, (b) a recent-window sanity/smoke-test dataset, (c) contract/ladder resolution.
